content: Jurisdictional boundaries of the Clstr trinity: 1) clstr.in has no geographic boundaries and targets all college students across India (pan-India digital campus OS); 2) vizag.clstr.in is strictly bounded to Vizag only (physical ground movement and local city community); 3) spark.clstr.in can be used by anyone anywhere (open ticketing and verified certificates for campus clubs and event organizers). Never conflate clstr.in's pan-India scope with vizag.clstr.in's city scope.
context: Any LinkedIn post, content drafting, outreach, product positioning, or ecosystem discussion mentioning Clstr products
